name: thatsoundslikeme-tauri
description: Tauri desktop distribution of ThatSoundsLikeMe for MuseHub.
author: ThatSoundsLikeMe contributors

scripts.check: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check && npm run build:web
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/release-guard.cjs mac && tauri build --bundles dmg --target universal-apple-darwin && node scripts/finalize-macos-dmg.cjs
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/release-guard.cjs win && tauri build --bundles nsis --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.release.conf.json && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/finalize-certum-windows-signing.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-certum-windows-signatures.ps1
